The `topology_boundary_auditor` mask shows fragmentation in the upper regions, supporting the Router's observation of structural collapse/fusion in the pink and green items. The Router underestimated the severity of the semantic failure; if the classifier can't identify the objects as food, the generation is fundamentally flawed beyond just 'texture anomalies'.
